text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm accompanying Symboli<n>Rudolf to the
Fleetfoot Festival, a<n>celebration for Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I gave the course a test run. The<n>positioning of the
targets and the<n>condition of the equipment all
seems<n>to be in order. The archery planning
committee has done an excellent job.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Student A
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you very much, President!<n>We're so
lucky to have you<n>performing the inspection
personally!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Student B
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, President. Could we<n>trouble you for
some guidance for this<n>year's archers?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It would be my pleasure. To call it<n>noblesse oblige
may be a bit much,<n>but it is undeniably my duty to
bestow<n>my knowledge upon them.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, Symboli Rudolf spends the<n>day making
sure the Fleetfoot<n>Festival goes smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your words at the closing ceremony<n>were
wonderful, President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Air Groove. Now, if you'll<n>excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Of course. Well, the festivities have<n>come to a
close. All that's left now is<n>to enjoy the rest of the
day. After all,<n>everybody needs a breather every
once in a while, including you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...? And what do we have here?

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Lady
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for all your hard work,<n>President! We've
extended our<n>opening hours for the day!
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, we didn't check out the stalls.
Come to think of it, we didn't check out the stalls.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You arranged all this for me? You<n>really shouldn't
have...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would have to be the most heartless<n>of tyrants to
disregard such a<n>courteous act. I shall be sure to
savor<n>this opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Farewell!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Bang!

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Staff
text_block_list.text: Wow! You're a great shot, President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Aha, thank you. I do have some<n>shooting range
experience.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My grandfather took me on a<n>few trips to
America, where I had the<n>opportunity to try my
hand.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Though Symboli Rudolf has an<n>explanation for her
shooting skills, her<n>talents don't end there.

text_block_list.name: Cookie Cutting Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
H-heavens! I've never seen anyone<n>cut a cookie
that intricate with such<n>precision! You're
unbelievably<n>dexterous!

text_block_list.name: Cotton Candy Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
Cotton candy! Make your own cotton<n>candy for
only a hundred yen! Whoa,<n>President, you're
really good at this!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, thank you very much. It<n>appears I still have
the muscle<n>memory from when I used to enjoy
handicraft. I suppose it is like riding a<n>bike.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I would hardly sayeverything...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But, come to think of it, passing on<n>knowledge and
experience is a thing<n>of great importance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer. I am generally the one<n>who comes to
you seeking advice...<n>but just for tonight, what if I
were to<n>impart my wisdom unto you?
choice_data_list: What happened to taking a breather?
What happened to taking a breather?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But it is. My proposition is a breath of<n>fresh air for
the both of us. Why<n>don't we take advantage of
this<n>opportunity to both experience a fresh
perspective?
choice_data_list: Okay, then. How about some shooting tips?

I want to know how to make picturesque cotton
candy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh. Shall we head back to the stall,<n>then?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer... Which prize takes your<n>fancy?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Urged to choose by Symboli Rudolf, I<n>point at the
prize that's caught my<n>eye—the one on the highest
shelf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
An excellent choice... Well then, allow<n>me to
assess your skills. Now, look<n>down the sight...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Bang!

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Staff
text_block_list.text: Ah, not quite! But nice try!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, you still have plenty<n>more shots. Try
to visualize the<n>trajectory and adjust your aim
after<n>any misses.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taking Symboli Rudolf's words to<n>heart, I assume
a more comfortable<n>position by resting my elbow
on the<n>counter. As I'm adjusting my aim...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Something lightly brushes my<n>shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...My apologies. I was too close.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I hope you will forgive me. I felt that I<n>had to share
your point of view in<n>order to offer satisfactory
advice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Not bad. Your aim is nearly on target.<n>Try aiming a
bit farther to the<n>bottom-right—yes, like that. Go
ahead<n>and give it another try.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf whispers words of<n>encouragement
in my ear, and I<n>adjust the muzzle according to
her<n>advice.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Bang!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Trainer! The prize is<n>yours!
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to your instruction!
It's all thanks to your instruction!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, well, that is quite some praise!<n>I've only
been your instructor for a<n>single evening, but what
a rewarding<n>one it has been.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling that Symboli Rudolf's<n>expression
seems warmer than<n>usual.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Picturesque, you say. Heh. Well, if I<n>am to meet
your expectations, I will<n>need to muster all of my
skill.

text_block_list.name: Cotton Candy Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, President! Nice to see you again!<n>Would you
like another go at the<n>cotton candy machine?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid not, but my trainer would.<n>Right, now
hold out the chopstick...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You should hold it up a little<n>higher. Gather
the sugar by twirling<n>the stick around... Good, now
move it<n>toward the bottom.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I try using the chopstick to fashion the<n>cotton
candy into the same shape as<n>Symboli Rudolf's
earlier effort, but to<n>no avail.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Pardon me. Let me give you a<n>demonstration.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf places her hands on<n>mine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this angle should work. Exactly.<n>Now spin it
like so.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Next, tilt the chopstick upwards... Very<n>good. That
should do nicely.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...And voila!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Retracting the chopstick from the<n>cotton candy
machine, I can hardly<n>believe that the
picture-perfect cotton<n>candy before me is my own
doing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Give it another try while the feeling is<n>still fresh.
Perhaps you could make<n>one for me this time?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, I do my very best to make a<n>nice, big ball
of cotton candy just for<n>Symboli Rudolf.
